nieuw.titel: Position your dragon to threaten several charge targets
nieuw.tekst: Position a dragon or other hammer so its charge arc covers as many targets as possible. Keep alternative targets available for redirecting the charge if the first target flees.
nieuw.waarom: He says units often flee from a dragon, and he values redirection because the new target has a limited set of charge reactions.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His dragon's position threatened bolt throwers, a crossbow unit, a Pegasus-mounted sorcerer and Dark Riders.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He recommends choosing the dragon's attack with an overrun path into another combat in mind.
